proposal.root_cause: Output-shape rules are too coarse: bare entity questions need all columns of every joined table, and attribute-listing questions ('What are the X, Y and Z ...') must select exactly those attributes rather than *
proposal.what: Rewrites the output-shape section of system_prompt.md with three explicit cases (attribute-list -> only those columns; bare entity question -> T1.* plus T2.* for each joined table; 'details' questions -> follow hint/typical Spider projection) and adds a rule to use DISTINCT when a one-to-many join can duplicate answer rows. This directly targets sp0755 (missing joined-table columns), sp0536 (duplicate rows from enrolment join) and sp0362 (wrong projection for a 'details' question).
